Title:  Solicitation - Repair of the F-15 Digital Mapping System (DMS) Advanced Display Core Processor (ADCP) 

  

 NAICS: 811210 

 PSC/FSC: J016 

  

 Notice ID:  FA8538-27-R-B004 

  

 The 409th Supply Chain Management Squadron (SCMS) / GUMA anticipates a five-year, Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Indefinite Delivery Contract (IDC) for the repair of the F-15 Advanced Display Core Processor (ADCP), NSN: 1270-01-562-6566FX, PN: 8525470-951 and Digital Map Processor (DMP), NSN: 5895-01-444-5142FX, PN: 8520305-911 to provide all the necessary parts and labor to test and repair the ADCP/DMP. The repair of the ADCP/ DMP is performed as a Direct Sales Partnership Agreement (DSPA) with the Government (WR-ALC/EMXG), supporting requirements generated for the Air Force Sustainment Center (AFSC), 638th Supply Chain Management Group (SCMG), 409th Supply Chain Management Squadron (SCMS)/GUMCA.The anticipated IDC will include one (1) 12-month basic year and four (4) one-year ordering periods. 

  

 The proposed contract action is for services for which the Government intends to solicit and negotiate using Other Than Full and Open Competition (OTF&OC) procedures in accordance with RFO Part 6.103-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements. The Government does not own any production level technical data or specialized test equipment in support of this requirement.  As a result, Honeywell International Inc. (CAGE 07187), is the only known source with adequate knowledge of the F-15 Digital Mapping System (DMS) Advanced Display Core Processor (ADCP) performance requirements and possession of the required technical data and capabilities needed to repair this item and ensure compatibility of the equipment. 

  

 The Government's required delivery schedule is 21 days after receipt of asset. The quantities shown below represent the Best Estimated Quantities for this effort.
